name: Oasive
long_description:
Oasive is an AI research platform that helps municipal bond investors decide which bonds to buy.

Before a fund buys a bond from a city, school district, hospital or airport, its analysts spend hours digging through PDFs, board meetings and local news. Oasive brings a borrower's audited financials, debt, board meetings and local news into one page built around what matters for that sector, with every number linked to its source.

Built by a former bond portfolio manager at Google Treasury and quant analyst at Wells Fargo.

launches.title: Oasive: Credit research for municipal bond investors
launches.tagline: Local news, board meetings and financials for every muni borrower, in one place
launches.body:
**TL;DR: Oasive is credit research for municipal bond investors, the people who lend to cities, schools and hospitals. Every day, we read local news and board meetings for each borrower and flag what matters for its credit, next to its full financials and bond structure. Every number links to its source.**

<https://youtu.be/wkmBMk-MFPw>

Hi, I'm Anaïs, founder of Oasive. I ran a $17B bond portfolio at Google Treasury, was a quant on Wells Fargo's $350B mortgage bond portfolio, and led AI product strategy at Google (AI Overviews, AI Mode, Gemini).

**The problem**

When a city builds a water plant or a school district builds a school, it usually pays by selling bonds. That's the $4.5 trillion muni market: about a million bonds and tens of thousands of borrowers.

Before a fund buys, a credit analyst has to decide whether the borrower will pay it back. The warning signs, like a lawsuit at a charter school or a budget gap in a small town, often show up only in a local paper or a board meeting. No database captures them. One analyst can cover up to 1,000 borrowers, so most of that news gets missed until it's too late.

**What Oasive does**

**Credit news and board meetings: know what changed, every day**

* **Credit news:** we search the news daily, keep only the credit-relevant stories, tag each one to its borrower and summarize it
* **Board meetings:** we read agendas and minutes and flag credit items with dollar amounts. Recordings are transcribed, with each point linked to its moment in the video
* **Ratings, leadership changes and new filings:** collected as they happen
* **Watchlists:** star the bonds and borrowers you follow and see all their news in one feed

**Research: two pages for every credit**

* **Borrower page:** multi-year audited financials, debt outstanding, the local economy and the metrics that matter for that sector. A hospital page shows days cash and patient volumes. An airport page shows passenger traffic and airline concentration. A city page shows its tax base and top taxpayers by name
* **Bond page:** what backs the bond, lien, reserve fund, call features, debt service and trading activity, with the official statement attached

**Ask Oasive AI:** ask plain-English questions about any credit and compare it with its peers. Every answer cites the audit, official statement or meeting recording it came from.

**Every number has a source:** each figure links to the document and page it came from, and we recheck figures against the documents every day.

We cover the whole muni market: cities and states, hospitals, universities, airports, toll roads, utilities, charter schools, senior living, prepaid energy and more.

Built with muni analysts at asset managers and insurers, who are using it today.

**Our ask**

Know someone who invests in muni bonds at an asset manager, bank, insurer or hedge fund? A warm intro goes a long way.

Email me at [anais@oasive.ai](mailto:anais@oasive.ai) or [request a demo here](https://www.oasive.ai/#book-demo).

launches.body:
**TL;DR: [Oasive](http://www.oasive.ai)** **helps bond investors find better bonds to buy. Compare investments and test trade ideas in minutes with proprietary models and a team of AI analysts.**

<https://youtu.be/HlMWxuHhlo8>

Hi, I'm Anaïs, founder of [Oasive](http://www.oasive.ai). I worked on Wells Fargo's $350B mortgage-backed securities (MBS) portfolio, then as a portfolio manager on Google Treasury's $17B MBS/ABS portfolio, before leading product strategy across Google's consumer AI products.

I'm building [Oasive](http://www.oasive.ai) to help more fixed income investors find value and act on it.

**The problem**

Finding an attractive trade is only the start. Is it really cheap, what could change that, and does it improve the portfolio? Answering those questions means going back and forth between research, market data, models and spreadsheets.

**What we built**

[Oasive](http://www.oasive.ai) helps you uncover opportunities you might otherwise miss, compare investments and test the risks before putting on a trade. Macro and Rates Research and our MBS Platform are live today:

* **Macro and Rates Research:** Which Treasury maturities look cheap, and is there a curve trade worth putting on? Use our proprietary valuation models to compare maturities, curve trades and butterflies. Check how many Fed cuts are priced in, dig into market moves and economic releases, and keep exploring with unlimited chats and follow-ups.
* **MBS Platform:** Which MBS pools look attractive, and why? Use proprietary prepayment models and collateral analysis to spot relative value and test investment ideas. If rates fall 1%, what happens to your portfolio? Change rate and prepayment assumptions to see the impact on spreads, duration and value across your holdings.

_Municipals, ABS, and corporates are next._

[Oasive](http://www.oasive.ai) is already used across 15+ institutional desks at global banks, asset managers with $100B+ in AUM, and Fortune 500 treasury teams.

**Try it**

Start your Macro and Rates Research free trial or request an MBS demo at <https://oasive.ai/join> — free and paid plans available.

**Our ask**

Know portfolio managers, traders or analysts on fixed-income desks? I’d love an introduction. Email [anais@oasive.ai](mailto:anais@oasive.ai)
